G3_arguments_hard_thresholded.note: Value.unflat maps bool fields with `next(it) >= .5`; the module is a step function of its soft arguments

G2_upstream_starvation.note: freezing the only consumer onto a module leaves the upstream node with no gradient path; Crystallizer.try_freeze detects this as 'disconnected remaining region' and rolls back

G4_choice_weight_still_learnable.note: the mixture weight over a frozen candidate receives gradient even though the candidate's output does not
